notes.title: Short Games Showcase + Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]The [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43212066/sale/shortgamesshowcase2025"]Short Games Showcase[/url] is here![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29776081/fc74f71276bd0f4e8c206d9fa196ea536828023d.png"][/img]Have you found yourself quoting the much-memed, "[i]I Want Shorter Games With Worse Graphics and I'm Not Kidding[/i]" ? Well then this showcase is for you![/p][p]These are games that don't bother with AAA ray-traced graphics, and cut the fat out of their narratives. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43212066/sale/shortgamesshowcase2025"]Explore the full event[/url] to find MANY discounted games that you can complete in a single evening![/p][p]A huge thank you to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ogrepixel/"]Ogre Pixel[/url] for organizing this event![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Where has Fancy Pants Man been!??[/b][/h3][p]A question we've been hearing a lot of lately...[/p][p]As we [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/668210/view/4222769301366741799"]shared a year ago[/url], Brad cracked Super FPA back open in order to optimize and improve the game. The hope was to clean the game up, improve stability on modern machines, and bring over some enhancements created for the Classic Pack. This ended up being a MUCH more challenging process than anticipated.[/p][p]In hindsight it may not have been the right time, as attempting to take this on created a massive development bottleneck for both titles. What was meant to be some casual bugfixing and optimizing quickly turned up a litany of other issues.[/p][p]Fixing one thing in Super inevitable broke two others. This quickly spun out of control, and meant needing to pour over every line of old code - all of which Brad has improved upon tenfold in the years since! Attempting to untangle that off the back of a hectic launch for Classic Pack led to developmental brickwall on both projects.[/p][p]Brad had to instead commit himself to learning Computer vision in Python in order to improve his technical abilities. This should significantly improve the process of debugging / repeated testing / uploading builds. Not very exciting stuff to provide updates on, while also largely not really being progress you can [i]show[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]TL;DR[/b][/h3][p]Brad is working on massive technical improvements for Super Fancy Pants Adventures.
Currently this is limited to a [url="https://www.patreon.com/bradborne"]Pantreon[/url]-only beta branch.
When this update is completed it will be applied to the game entirely for free.
At that time, we'll be ready to move back to the Classic Pack and the future of all things Fancy Pants!

Thank you for your patience!!
-Graeme
(2 Left Thumbs)[/p]

notes.title: Summer Sale 2024 + Update beta
notes.notes:
[h2]The annual [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] is here!![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29776081/985ad6d38f5cefc5597a24afbff80897c7fd6738.png[/img]

Thousands of games are on sale across Steam, including a [b]50% discount[/b] on Super Fancy Pants Adventure! Consider grabbing the game bundled with the Classic Pack for additional savings ([i]or scope out one of the other bundles offered this sale[/i]).

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22346/The_Complete_Fancy_Pants_Adventures/

The entire [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/2leftthumbs]2 Left Thumbs[/url] publishing catalog is on sale. Be sure to browser that selection to see what other quality games might strike your [i]fancy[/i].

[h2]UPDATE?[/h2]
Brad has been hard at work on a new update for Super!! This is primarily to address performance and stability - as that has depreciated some over the last ~7 years.

This can be accessed in the [b]SFPA Beta[/b] branch:
[i]Right click the game in your Steam library > Properties > Beta tab > use code "kittenkabootle" > Check code > Select the beta in the dropdown[/i]
You should see an update initiate, which confirms it has worked!

Your feedback on this beta would be greatly appreciated!!
We wanted to have this public in time for the sale, but the current build isn't [i]quite[/i] stable enough. This update ended up being a LOT more effort than anyone was expecting! We should have more to share "soon".

[h2]COMING SOON[/h2]
A new game published by 2 Left Thumbs, hailing from another legendary Flash dev, is coming soon!

Keep an eye out for [b]Gorgon Shield[/b], from the creator of [i]Swords and Sandals[/i]. It is a party-based RPG, arcade, roguelike. And I can guarantee you haven't played another quite like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446920/Gorgon_Shield/

There is large demo for you to play around in. And please be sure to add it to your [b]Wishlist[/b]!
